datasets.development: exact1110 entries of Phase16D stop_events.csv, including657 SL gate events
datasets.evaluation: all241 Phase18 actual ALL_UNSAFE selection decisions: SLW210 LC19 CL12
datasets.ordering: dev CSV order; eval Phase18 frozen main_order then FRESH event order
datasets.example_selection: first eval event of TRUE_BLOCK and MARGINAL, chosen in inventory before any saved-event repair solve

initialization.anchor: native world XY transformed by its own observation pose; never rigid re-anchor the full sample
initialization.projection: protected XYPath nearest projection of B
initialization.reference: polyline [B, projected point, suffix original vertices], duplicates removed by XYPath; uniform arclength8 samples; q0=B
initialization.objective_reference: resampled qhat, not raw sample indices

variables: p1..p7 XY (14 scalars), fixed p0=B position, no yaw/time variables

objective.heading: 2*sin((atan2(p1-b)-theta_B)/2)/sigma_h; measured B yaw, no native yaw

constraints.certificate: Snapshot.exact_clearance to occupied cell centers minus radius >=.025, no oracle boxes/wall halfplanes
constraints.fixed_B: never moved; an impossible fixed-B constraint is recorded but eligible samples still receive exactly one solve

solver.jacobian: analytic for residuals and all constraints; inherited Menger derivative
solver.acceptance: success AND raw-unit max constraint/bound violation <=1e-7 AND exact depth certificate

selection.rule: minimum mean Euclidean edit among accepted paths, then lowest sample index
selection.mean_edit: over all8 resampled-reference points including fixed zero-edit B; max over same8
selection.freshest_only: original largest remaining suffix length, ties lower index; reuse its one solve, no second solve

causes.event: Phase16D first-match with n=1: MARGINAL if max oracle suffix clearance in [0,.025), else TRUE_BLOCK if all8<0, else NEAR_START if query(B)-h/sqrt2<.025, else OTHER
causes.run: also record same70percent Phase16D aggregate rule, separately from event-cause success rates
causes.oracle_scope: posthoc labels, safety evaluation and plotting only; never repair or selection input

rollout.initial_speed: actual incoming 72Hz speed at B, before new decision command
rollout.heading: actual B yaw; no preparatory rotation
rollout.termination: same endpoint/horizon/negative conservative oracle bound as Phase18D; exact negative witness separately

timing.sample: initialize + necessary-bound diagnostic + solve + exact certificate; no file I/O or oracle evaluation
timing.decision_p95: solver-started eligible samples; short/degenerate exclusions separate
timing.eight: actual serial wall time of all8 decisions, before oracle evaluation/rollout

decision.unsafe: any accepted sample repair has oracle box/wall footprint clearance<0 OR selected-event rollout overlap fraction>.01
decision.viable: not unsafe AND success fraction>=.50 AND selected mean-edit median<=.15m AND eligible-sample solve p95<=.20s
decision.slow: not unsafe and success>=.50 but timing or edit gate fails
decision.zero_repairs: REPAIR_RARE; rollout fraction unavailable and safety_evidence_available=false, no claim of safety validation

recovery_reference: Phase17/18 saved main-run recovery summaries and exact Phase18 trigger-event links; not an offline replay or matched causal comparison

tests.free: straight uniformly sampled x=0..0.7, y0, B(0,0,0)
tests.blocking: occupied grid box x[.55,.75], y[-.25,-.03], radius .09; robot footprint intersects a straight x0..1.4,y0 path
